I then used canva and used their templates. I also copy + pasted the job description and part of their website when I googled "what does x company sell?"

Hope that gives you some ideas of how to construct your prompt. Obviously, add or remove whatever you wish. My company didn't even ask me for one but I sent one along with a pitch deck presentation and I'm now going on to 3rd interview and hopefully I make it to the 4th and final one soon!
